# Diagnostic code

A stable `MGSxxxx` identifier attached to a magus warning or error, so it can be
referenced and looked up; some are guardrails (see [wards](../concepts/wards.md)), others hard
errors.

## Example

```sh
magus query "kind=diagnostic MGS8001"
```
